dedupe_keys.name: lieux de stationnement de saint maur des fosses

description: Lieux de stationnement de Saint-Maur-des-Fossés is a dataset listed in Data Saint-Maur open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Gouvernance des données Saint-Maur-des-Fossés. La liste des parkings de la ville de Saint Maur des fossés conforme au modèle du socle commun des données locales. Coverage: Saint-Maur-des-Fossés. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Indigo, Yespark, socle commun des données locales. The portal shows 9 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-saint-maur-com-portal.
